classification.difficultyReason: Interpret three supplied area expressions as different divisions or completions of the same composite figure.

content.prompt:
These three calculations show three ways to find the area of this shape.
Split the shape to represent these calculations.

spec.description: Unshaded L-shaped outline with the taller section on the left and a lower extension on the right. Retains the source's schematic proportions.
spec.mathematics: Left side 12 cm; top edge 6 cm; entire bottom edge 10 cm; right side 5 cm. Diagram is not to scale.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied blue vertical division line is omitted from the question figure.

answer.short: Draw a vertical line from the inward corner to the bottom edge.
answer.worked: Draw a vertical line from the inward corner to the bottom edge. The right-hand rectangle has width $10-6=4\ \text{cm}$. The two rectangle areas are $12\times6$ and $5\times4$.

spec.description: Complete labelled figure with the supplied vertical division from the inward corner to the bottom edge.
spec.mathematics: The division produces rectangles of dimensions 12 cm by 6 cm and 5 cm by 4 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: The blue division line is solution-only.

spec.description: The same unshaded L-shaped outline and four measurements, retaining the source's schematic proportions.
spec.mathematics: Left side 12 cm; top edge 6 cm; entire bottom edge 10 cm; right side 5 cm. Diagram is not to scale.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied blue horizontal division line is omitted from the question figure.

answer.short: Draw a horizontal line from the inward corner to the left edge.
answer.worked: Draw a horizontal line from the inward corner to the left edge. The upper rectangle has height $12-5=7\ \text{cm}$. The two rectangle areas are $10\times5$ and $6\times7$.

spec.description: Complete labelled figure with the supplied horizontal division from the left edge to the inward corner.
spec.mathematics: The division produces rectangles of dimensions 10 cm by 5 cm and 6 cm by 7 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: The blue division line is solution-only.

spec.description: The same unshaded L-shaped outline and four measurements, retaining the source's schematic proportions.
spec.mathematics: Left side 12 cm; top edge 6 cm; entire bottom edge 10 cm; right side 5 cm. Diagram is not to scale.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied blue completion lines around the missing upper-right rectangle are omitted from the question figure.

answer.short: Extend the top edge to the right and the right edge upward to complete the enclosing rectangle.
answer.worked: Complete the enclosing $12\ \text{cm}$ by $10\ \text{cm}$ rectangle. The missing upper-right rectangle has width $10-6=4\ \text{cm}$ and height $12-5=7\ \text{cm}$, so its area is subtracted.

spec.description: Complete labelled figure with the supplied top and right extensions enclosing the missing upper-right rectangle.
spec.mathematics: The enclosing rectangle is 12 cm by 10 cm; the missing rectangle is 4 cm by 7 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: The two blue completion lines are solution-only.
